python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = '/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/docs/php/streams.md'
s = open(p).read()
old = "| `compress.bzip2://` | Read-only wrapper that opens the underlying file and applies `bzip2.decompress`. |"
if old not in s:
    import re
    m = [l for l in s.split('\n') if 'compress.bzip2://' in l and l.startswith('|')]
    print("current row:", m[:1])
else:
    new = ("| `compress.bzip2://` | Opens the underlying file and applies `bzip2.decompress` when reading or "
           "`bzip2.compress` when writing, so `fopen(\"compress.bzip2://out.bz2\", \"w\")` writes a real bzip2 "
           "stream. php exposes no context option for the block size, so the wrapper uses its defaults — block "
           "size 9, work factor 0. The URL may be a literal or built at run time. |")
    s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
    open(p, 'w').write(s)
    print("doc updated")
